title: License Validation Result
description: The deterministic output of resolve_license_status() -- never an LLM judgment, per docs/architecture/visual-asset-pipeline.md#license-validation. unknown and incompatible are hard-blocked from final rendering by visual_quality_control's hard-fail rule.

license_type.description: The raw provider/license descriptor this status was derived from (e.g. "CC BY 4.0", "Pexels License").
